subject: Search & grounding follow-up: proposed retrieval configs, reranker tradeoffs, and benchmark links
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference>
To: Priyanka Shah <priyanka@heliohealth.com>, Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Search & grounding follow-up: proposed retrieval configs, reranker tradeoffs, and benchmark links

Hi Priyanka / Tom —

Great demo earlier today — thanks for walking through the physician-search workflow. Per our conversation, I captured the immediate priorities and an initial proposal you can review:

1) Primary goal: reduce hallucination in patient-facing summaries while keeping median latency under 250ms for search+generate flows.
2) Success metrics to track in the pilot: recall@10 (retriever), precision@1 for answers, and a grounding-fidelity score (we've been using a combination of exact-quote rate + manual faithfulness checks). Target: recall@10 >= 0.85, precision@1 >= 0.78, grounding-fidelity >= 0.80.
3) Retrieval proposal (starter):
   - Vector store: Faiss HNSW (flat index) with cosine similarity, 768-d vectors (we recommend trying both 768 and 1024 dims depending on embeddings).
   - Retriever top_k sweep: [5, 10, 20] (we'll benchmark latency vs QA recall).
   - Text chunking: 500-token overlap 100 tokens (doc-aware sections for clinical notes).
4) Reranker options:
   - Fast path: bi-encoder reranker for low-latency reordering (good when you need throughput).
   - High-quality path: cross-encoder re-ranker (cross-attention) for final top-5 re-ranking when accuracy matters more than a 50–100ms latency hit.

Attached: a lightweight benchmark CSV with initial synthetic probe results and the prompt set we discussed (mvp_prompt_set_v2.txt).

Next steps I suggest:
- Your team: confirm the two pilot datasets (sample clinical notes + FAQ corpus) and share any existing embeddings if available.
- Our side: Connor will run a quick eval sweep (5/10/20 k) against the probe set and attach the full recall/latency matrix.
- Decision point: pick reranker strategy (bi-encoder vs cross-encoder) for the pilot Scope A. If you want, we can do a hybrid: bi-encoder in prod with on-demand cross-encoder for low-confidence queries.

Can you confirm the pilot datasets and whether your security/compliance team needs any other artifacts up front?

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min call to walk through the CSV if that's easier.

—
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.inference
Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Search & grounding follow-up: proposed retrieval configs, reranker tradeoffs, and benchmark links

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks — this is exactly what we needed to move forward. A few clarifying Qs from our side after reviewing the CSV:

1) On the vector dims — do you recommend starting with 768 and then switching to 1024 only if we see recall loss? We're sensitive to index size (storage) but care more about recall.
2) For the cross-encoder latency hit, can you quantify the ballpark CPU/GPU cost delta? Our procurement team will need a rough monthly delta for the two options.
3) For grounding-fidelity, do you have an automated proxy metric we can run so we don't rely solely on manual checks?

Tom and I confirmed the two pilot datasets: (a) 2,500 anonymized consult notes, (b) 1,200 clinician-facing FAQs. We'll share the S3 location by EOD tomorrow.

If possible, we would prefer a hybrid approach you mentioned — bi-encoder by default with cross-encoder fallback for low confidence queries.

Thanks — Priyanka
Director, Search & Clinical UX
HelioHealth
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference>
To: Priyanka Shah <priyanka@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.inference>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Search & grounding follow-up: proposed retrieval configs, reranker tradeoffs, and benchmark links

Thanks for the quick reply — glad the CSV was useful. Quick answers and proposed owner/action items below: 

1) Vector dims: start with 768. Our recommended flow is: run baseline (768) -> if recall@10 < 0.82 on your consult notes, move to 1024. The storage delta is roughly 33% larger for embeddings at 1024 vs 768. Connor: can you add storage delta numbers to the benchmark sheet?

2) Cross-encoder cost: approximate guidance
   - Bi-encoder reranker: negligible incremental GPU cost if you pre-compute reranker embeddings; extra cost mainly in vector similarity ops (CPU/GPU minimal).
   - Cross-encoder re-rank (on top-20): ~60–120ms extra per request on a vCPU-only path; on GPU (T4/A10) ~20–40ms. Cost delta varies by qps — rough estimate: 2–3x token/GPU cost when you enable cross-encoder for top-5 per request. Marcus: I'll need a short cost calc for monthly delta given expected pilot qps (Priyanka, any expected QPS for search flows?).

3) Automated proxy for grounding-fidelity: we recommend two signals combined: exact-quote overlap (string match %) and a model-based faithfulness classifier (lightweight cross-encoder trained to score answer->source pairs). The classifier gives a continuous score; thresholding plus periodic manual audits works well. Soojin: can you attach the small classifier notebook and inference-time cost notes?

Action items:
- Priyanka/Tom: share S3 paths and expected QPS (estimate).
- Connor: run the retrieval sweep (top_k [5,10,20], dims [768,1024]) on the provided probe set and add recall@k + median latency to helio_rag_benchmarks_v1.csv.
- Marcus: rough monthly cost delta for bi-encoder-only vs hybrid cross-encoder fallback (assume 1k requests/day for pilot as baseline until Helio confirms).
- Soojin: classifier notebook + inference-cost note in the Drive link.

I'll loop back with an updated CSV and a short doc that maps tradeoffs to pilot acceptance criteria. If it's helpful, we can schedule a 30-min tech sync for next week.

—
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Hi all —

Quick update: I ran the first sweep overnight against the probe set Jasmine shared. High-level findings in the attached CSV (full matrix in Drive):

- 768 dims, top_k=10: recall@10 = 0.83, median end-to-end latency (retriever + bi-encoder rerank + model prompt) = 210ms
- 1024 dims, top_k=10: recall@10 = 0.88, latency + storage delta as noted in sheet
- Cross-encoder re-rank on top-20 improves precision@1 from 0.76 -> 0.82 but adds ~80ms on CPU path (GPU path ~30ms).

Recommendation for pilot Scope A (balanced accuracy + latency):
- Use 768-d vectors with top_k=10 and bi-encoder reranker in prod.
- Enable cross-encoder fallback when bi-encoder confidence < 0.6 or when the user-facing downstream score is low (we included a confidence-calibration script in Drive).

I've uploaded helio_rag_benchmarks_v1.csv (summary rows) and the full matrix to the Drive folder linked earlier. Also uploaded mvp_prompt_set_v2.txt with a short note about prompt templates that lower hallucination risk (explicit source quoting + instruction to cite source sections).

Priyanka: can you confirm the pilot start window? If you want, Marcus and I can join the kickoff to run a quick live sweep and finalize the cost calc.

Thanks —
Connor O'Brien
ML Solutions | Redwood Inference
